answer: Correlation splitting: the ledger clusters agents whose answers, timing and wallet hops move in lockstep, and a cluster shares one reward pool split among members. A farm of fake agents looks hollow, like bees bringing identical nectar from one flower, so N clones earn what one honest agent earns while each still pays its own fee. Hiding needs truly independent models and schedules, a cost as solid as basalt that rises with every extra identity.
